mvp_baseline: Owner-approved local-first Windows sales core P0; P1 modules optional; execution authorization remains limited to D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32 and the D-33 presentation-only UI scope.
change_summary: Added the in-app quick settings panel: static server-rendered markup in the main layout plus a small vanilla script, opened from the conventional help button in the header or by F1 / ?, labelled with a SETTINGS chip, and limited to theme, font size and interface density stored in the browser.

The panel shows read-only store facts (name, currency, credit sales allowed, inventory enabled) and links to the full settings page; anything affecting money, data or permissions stays in /settings only.

Added automatic persistence of an unfinished sale cart in the cashier's browser, restored on return with a clear notice and a start-new-sale action, expiring after 24 hours and always re-reading prices and stock from the database.
Fixed the blank theme flash by applying the stored presentation preferences before the page renders.
Recorded decision D-33 and the verification evidence in docs/DECISIONS_AND_OPEN_GATES.md; no MVP scope or prior limited authorization changed.
review_findings: Build and tests after the change: dotnet build Wizz.sln -c Release = 0 errors (pre-existing StyleCop warnings only); Domain 24/24; Integration 262/262 (286 total).

Browser verification on an isolated instance with a temporary SQLite database (deleted afterwards): the panel opens and closes (button, F1, ? and Esc), the SETTINGS chip and title are correct, store facts render, and theme (rgb(241,245,249) light / rgb(31,31,31) dark), large font (18px) and compact density all apply while the page URL and the live page state stay unchanged.

Cart continuity evidence on the same isolated instance: a cart with quantity 3 and a 50 discount (total 1,300.00) survived panel use, was restored after navigating to /settings and back with the restore notice and identical values, start-new-sale cleared both cart and draft, and a completed sale (450.00 DZD) cleared the draft with no leftover data.

Diagnosis recorded but not fixed: /sales, /cash, /purchases and any unknown URL return an empty-body 404 (blank white page), and the leftover stock-movements link in the products page still points to a removed page. This remains open pending the owner's order.

Limitation: the 286 automated tests do not cover browser behaviour of the panel or the draft; the evidence above is manual and was not reproduced in CI because GitHub Actions remains unavailable for the account.
Execution remains unauthorized outside the recorded limited scopes (D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32, D-33). Phase 3 remains unauthorized.
